ck_categories_slug.name: ck_categories_slug
ck_categories_slug.value:
"categories"."slug" = lower(trim("categories"."slug"))
        AND length("categories"."slug") > 0
        AND "categories"."slug" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*'
        AND "categories"."slug" NOT LIKE '-%'
        AND "categories"."slug" NOT LIKE '%-'
        AND "categories"."slug" NOT LIKE '%--%'

ck_products_slug.name: ck_products_slug
ck_products_slug.value:
"products"."slug" = lower(trim("products"."slug"))
        AND length("products"."slug") > 0
        AND "products"."slug" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*'
        AND "products"."slug" NOT LIKE '-%'
        AND "products"."slug" NOT LIKE '%-'
        AND "products"."slug" NOT LIKE '%--%'

ck_returns_processed_at.name: ck_returns_processed_at
ck_returns_processed_at.value: "returns"."status" NOT IN ('rejected', 'refunded') OR "returns"."processed_at" IS NOT NULL

ck_shop_approval_state.name: ck_shop_approval_state
ck_shop_approval_state.value:
(
        "shop_profiles"."approval_status" = 'pending'
        AND "shop_profiles"."approved_by" IS NULL
        AND "shop_profiles"."approved_at" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "shop_profiles"."approval_status" = 'approved'
        AND "shop_profiles"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL
        AND "shop_profiles"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL
      ) OR (
        "shop_profiles"."approval_status" IN ('rejected', 'suspended')
        AND "shop_profiles"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL
        AND "shop_profiles"."approved_at" IS NULL
      )

ck_users_auth_method.name: ck_users_auth_method
ck_users_auth_method.value: "users"."password" IS NOT NULL OR "users"."email_verified_at" IS NOT NULL

ck_users_deleted_state.name: ck_users_deleted_state
ck_users_deleted_state.value:
(
        "users"."status" = 'deleted'
        AND "users"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL
      ) OR (
        "users"."status" <> 'deleted'
        AND "users"."deleted_at" IS NULL
      )
